I work at the intersection of business, finance and data.

My background combines ICT, Data Science and Finance with hands-on experience in business processes, client requirements and stakeholder collaboration. I am interested in the point where analysis stops being an academic exercise and starts improving a real decision.

I approach problems by first understanding the business question, then choosing the simplest analytical method that can answer it reliably. That can mean structuring requirements, working through financial drivers, cleaning and analysing data, or translating findings into a recommendation that non-technical stakeholders can use.

I am currently pursuing an MSc in Data Science & Finance at the University of Zurich. I am especially interested in roles where analytical depth, commercial awareness and clear communication need to work together.
